purpose: Teach: プロレタリアート/ユニバーサル/中日/ヘクタール/コンプレックス/アンチ/電脳/乙女

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、プロレタリアート的階層意識を持ち込むな
lines.en: Don't bring class consciousness into this company.
lines.style: Clipped, authoritative. Sharp attack on each clause. No warmth — this is correction, not discussion. Measured tempo but unyielding.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。ユニバーサルデザインを採用します
lines.en: Understood. We'll implement universal design principles.
lines.style: Respectful but not obsequious. Steady, assured delivery. Takes the instruction seriously without fawning. Professional acknowledgment.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、中日貿易のリスクを管理しろ
lines.en: Manage the risks in our China-Japan trade operations.
lines.style: Direct, businesslike. Slight emphasis on 'manage' — this is non-negotiable. No room for hedging. Cool and clear-eyed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。土地のヘクタール表記を統一します
lines.en: Yes. I'll standardize our land measurement units across all materials.
lines.style: Focused, deliberate. Shows he's taken the specific instruction and is committing to concrete action. Slightly faster than before — he's ready to move.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 社員のコンプレックスを刺激する広告はやめろ
lines.en: Stop running advertisements that exploit staff insecurities.
lines.style: Firmer than the previous directives. Moral weight underneath the command. Slower, more deliberate — this matters beyond business metrics. Gaze steady.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。アンチ層への対応も丁寧にします
lines.en: Understood. We'll also be thoughtful in how we address our critics and skeptics.
lines.style: Respectful nod to the ethical dimension. Not just 'yes, sir' — he's demonstrating he understands the principle, not just the order. Warm agreement.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、電脳化経営、つまりデジタル経営を推進しろ
lines.en: Push the company toward digital transformation — full cyber-management operations.
lines.style: Emphatic on 'digital transformation.' This is the vision statement, the exciting part. More energy than previous directives. Forward-looking, almost visionary.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。乙女向け新製品ラインも検討します
lines.en: Understood. We're also exploring a new product line for women's markets.
lines.style: Confident closure. Shows initiative — he's not just following orders but already thinking about applications. Bright, solutions-oriented finish.
